sections.heading: Scope of Cover
sections.body: The Policy indemnifies the Insured Persons for reasonable and customary medical expenses incurred on in-patient hospitalisation for a minimum period of 24 consecutive hours, day care procedures, pre-hospitalisation expenses up to 30 days and post-hospitalisation expenses up to 60 days, and road ambulance charges, subject to the floater limit per family shown in the Schedule. Room rent is restricted to 1% of the family floater limit per day for normal rooms and 2% per day for ICU. Maternity cover is included with a sub-limit as per the Annexure.

sections.heading: Waiting Periods and Exclusions
sections.body: The 30-day initial waiting period, the first-year exclusion for specified diseases and the waiting period for pre-existing diseases are waived for this group. Standard exclusions apply, including cosmetic or aesthetic treatment, treatment arising from alcohol or substance abuse, self-inflicted injury, war and nuclear perils, experimental treatment, and expenses not medically necessary, as detailed in the Policy Wordings.

sections.heading: Claims Procedure
sections.body: For cashless treatment at a network hospital, the Insured Person shall present the health card issued by the in-house Health Administration Team and the hospital will seek pre-authorisation. For reimbursement claims, intimation must be given within 48 hours of admission and the claim documents submitted within 30 days of discharge. Claims helpline: 1800-425-7713 (toll free), email: healthclaims@deccanshield.example.

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: Any grievance may be addressed to the Grievance Redressal Officer at the Registered Office or at grievance@deccanshield.example. If the complaint is not resolved within 15 days, the policyholder may approach the Insurance Ombudsman, Ahmedabad, as per the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, or register the grievance through the Bima Bharosa portal of IRDAI.

sections.heading: Important Notes
sections.body: This Schedule is to be read together with the Policy Wordings and Endorsements, if any. Additions and deletions of members during the policy period shall be effected on pro-rata basis. Stamp duty has been paid by consolidated method. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Deccan Shield Insurance Limited, IRDAI Registration No. 187, CIN U66010TG2015PLC098734.
